title: Tessera Template
description: Schema for validating Tessera YAML template definitions

description.description: Brief description of what this template creates

sections.description: Ordered list of sections that compose the template

export.description: Supported export formats for artifacts created from this template

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag for the template's section titles and prompts. Defaults to 'en' when omitted. Localized template variants live under `templates/<category>/locales/<locale>/` and share the same base id with a locale suffix (e.g. `prd-v1-es`, `prd-v1-ja`).

industry.description: Industry domains this template is tailored for (e.g. 'healthcare', 'legal', 'education', 'government', 'finance', 'manufacturing', 'retail', 'nonprofit', 'creative', 'real-estate'). Omitting this field means the template is industry-agnostic. Multiple values are permitted for cross-industry templates.

profile.description: Intended user profile(s) this template was authored for (e.g. 'executive', 'analyst', 'teacher', 'nurse', 'product-manager', 'engineer'). Used by the CreatePage UI to filter and rank templates per the current user's profile preferences.

format.description: Optional output format hint for the renderer (e.g. 'marp' for slide decks that should be rendered through Marp Core). Mirrors the Rust struct's `format` field.

theme.description: Optional preferred theme when the renderer supports themed output (e.g. Marp 'default' / 'gaia' / 'uncover').

paginate.description: Whether the rendering engine should paginate output. Marp uses this directly; other engines may ignore it.

marp_template.description: Optional raw Marp markdown body. When present the template engine can emit Marp output directly without re-rendering from sections.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for LLM generation of this section

output_format.description: Expected output structure for this section

min.description: Minimum number of sources of this type required
